subject: Activation paths and minimum-GPU guardrails for TideWell Dedicated
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@tidewell.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity options — need min-GPU and activation windows

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the call this morning. As mentioned, our primary asks for the proposal are:
- a clear minimum-GPU guarantee (we need hard guardrails for finance),
- a recommended ramp schedule tied to our quarterly feature launches, and
- fallback/burst behavior if traffic overshoots.

Traffic profile (rough): 45M tokens/day steady by Q4, with 2x peaks on demo days.
Key constraint: procurement needs an activation window and a calendar-friendly ramp (no surprise billing).

Attached is the RFP and the usage histogram we discussed. Can you send a short options matrix by EOD?

Thanks — looping procurement for visibility (procurement@tidewell.ai).

—Samir
Samir Khan
Head of ML Platforms, TideWell AI
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@tidewell.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options — need min-GPU and activation windows

Samir — thanks for the RFP and the histogram. Attached is a concise options pack (PDF) with three activation paths we think map cleanly to TideWell's launch cadence. Summary below — I've kept it action-focused so procurement can pick a path quickly.

Option A — Guardrail Baseline (predictable, lower burn):
- Min GPUs (guaranteed): 12 x A100-equivalent (steady-state); burst pool: +8 on-demand.
- Ramp: 12 -> 12 (month 0), 12 -> 18 (month 2), stabilize at 24 (month 4) if usage growth meets thresholds.
- Warmup credits: 200k tokens for model cache priming during activation windows (one-time).
- Fallback: auto-route to a quantized variant (Q4/8-bit) with 10–15% latency uplift but 2.3x cost savings if capacity constrained.

Option B — Staged Ladder (conservative growth control):
- Min GPUs: 8 (guarantee) with scheduled +8 activations every 30 days for three steps (8->16->24->32).
- Ramp schedule tied to milestone triggers (prod test, pilot, GA).
- Warmup credits: 100k tokens per step.
- Pricing: blended monthly reservation price + usage-based burst invoice.

Option C — Burst-first (fast time-to-scale):
- Min GPUs: 6 guarantee, large burst pool committed (reserve 40% of projected peak).
- Designed for teams who prioritize launch velocity — higher unit cost, shorter commit term (3 months).
- Includes a rollback policy: if burst > 60% for >4 weeks, automatic review + optional floor upgrade.

Notes / recommendations:
- We recommend Option B for predictable cost + staged confidence. Option A is best if finance wants a higher baseline to avoid mid-quarter upgrades.
- Aditya (cc'd) and Ben will provide SLO and perf tradeoffs — Ben is adding a perf appendix with the 95th-pctl latency and steady-state tokens/sec estimates.

Next steps: If procurement likes one of these, we can seed a formal SOW and a carve-out for activation dates. Want me to draft the SOW stub for procurement?

Regards,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: TideWell_Dedicated_Options_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@tidewell.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04 10:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options — technical appendix (latency, warmup, KB)

Samir / Chloe — quick technical appendix, bullet-style so it plugs into the SOW: 

Performance assumptions (for 12 A100-equivalent baseline):
- Steady-state throughput: ~5.2M tokens/hour with a 2048 context 50-token avg response mix.
- 95th-pctl latency: ~220ms with continuous batching enabled and KV cache primed.
- Cold-start warmup: ~12–18 minutes for a 12-GPU lane depending on model size; warmup credits are to pre-warm KV caches and minimize tail latencies during activation.

Min-GPU guardrail rationale:
- 6 GPUs: supports lightweight inference and quick demos but will show latency variance under sustained peak (not recommended for core GA).
- 8 GPUs: OK for pilot with strict throttling on long-tail UX paths.
- 12 GPUs: recommended minimum for GA to hit 95th-pctl latency target under your projected Q4 load.

Autoscale and burst behavior:
- Autoscale adds burst GPUs in ~3–7 minutes depending on free pool availability; guaranteed burst pool reduces that to ~90–180s.
- When bursting to quantized variants, expect ~10–20% accuracy delta on edge cases; we can gate that behind traffic-splitting for canary.

Operational controls we suggest including in the SOW:
- Scheduled activation windows with a 48-hour pre-warm call.
- Warmup credit consumption telemetry (separate CSV in monthly billing).
- Automatic rollback trigger if error rate or 95th-pctl latency exceeds threshold for >30 minutes.

I've attached the KPI sheet with token math (ben_kpi_estimates.xlsx) and a quick perf graph exported from our perf lab. Happy to run a short smoke test on your staging dataset (30–60 minutes) prior to GA.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachments: ben_kpi_estimates.xlsx

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity options — Activation paths and minimum-GPU guardrails for TideWell Dedicated

Chloe / Ben — this is perfect, thanks. Procurement is leaning to Option B but wants the SOW stub and exact activation windows (we prefer month-bound steps so our finance can align). Two quick asks before we circulate to legal:

1) Can you put the warmup credit accounting in a short clause (how credits are consumed and returned if activation delayed)?
2) We need an explicit clause about first-month prorate if we hit step-2 earlier than scheduled.

Procurement contact (procurement@tidewell.ai) will expect a 1-page SOW stub and a redlineable term sheet. If you can drop the SOW stub into the Drive link you have and ping me, I'll get it to legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to run a 60-minute perf smoke the week of May 10 if you can provision a staging lane.

—Samir
